prompts.applies_when: The business claims a Singapore Website Awards award
prompts.question: Does the claimed Singapore Website Awards project, year, category and award match the organiser’s published record?
prompts.why_it_matters: Accurate award attribution matters to prospective clients.
prompts.how_to_query: Compare the claimed project and agency credit to the organiser’s winners and past-year pages; check exact year and award tier.
prompts.found_when: The same project record explicitly contradicts the firm’s specific claim, with agency role confirmed.
prompts.not_found_when: The relevant organiser record confirms the specific claim and attribution.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Year outside available archive, no match, identity uncertain or incomplete coverage.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.

prompts.applies_when: The agency claims to be an SGNIC accredited registrar
prompts.question: Is the specific legal entity listed by SGNIC as an accredited registrar for the claimed domain extension?
prompts.why_it_matters: Offering domain services does not itself make an agency an accredited registrar.
prompts.how_to_query: Compare exact legal name and the applicable extension against the SGNIC registrar list. Do not equate a reseller with an accredited registrar.
prompts.found_when: An explicit direct accreditation claim conflicts with the verified current list and exact legal entity.
prompts.not_found_when: The same entity is listed for the claimed extension.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: List unavailable, identity uncertain, or the claim only concerns reseller or partner status.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.

prompts.applies_when: The agency claims a named IMDA pre-approved web or e-commerce solution or PSG eligibility
prompts.question: Does the exact vendor and solution match the applicable official pre-approved solution record?
prompts.why_it_matters: Grant claims need solution-specific support and customer eligibility is conditional.
prompts.manual_reason: A current solution lookup may require an interactive or authenticated portal.
prompts.how_to_query: Identify exact solution, vendor, approval period and any reseller relationship; compare against current official solution listing and terms.
prompts.found_when: A confirmed current official record contradicts the specific solution or grant claim.
prompts.not_found_when: The official record matches the solution and vendor and the statement preserves customer eligibility conditions.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Record cannot be accessed, current dates unknown or reseller status not verifiable.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.

prompts.applies_when: The firm claims the CSA Cyber Essentials or Cyber Trust mark
prompts.question: Does the certification claim match the exact certified organisation, mark and validity?
prompts.why_it_matters: Organisational cybersecurity certification does not certify every website produced.
prompts.manual_reason: A complete public register and machine-readable access were not established.
prompts.how_to_query: Locate the official current mark holder list or verify the certificate with its issuer; compare entity, mark and dates.
prompts.found_when: Verified certification details conflict with an explicit claim.
prompts.not_found_when: The official evidence matches entity, mark and validity.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: No public current list, certificate unavailable, unclear scope or identity.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.
